---
title: "Photo Gallery"
---

Scenes from the field, the lab, and everywhere in between.

<!-- ===================================================================
     SLIDESHOW
     Built with the Bootstrap carousel that already ships with the site
     theme - no Quarto extension or R package required.

     TO ADD A PHOTO:
       1. Drop the image file into the images/ folder.
       2. Copy one <div class="carousel-item"> ... </div> block below,
          paste it inside <div class="carousel-inner">, and update the
          src, alt, and caption. Remove the word "active" from the copy -
          exactly one slide may be "active".
       3. Add one more <button> to <div class="carousel-indicators">,
          incrementing data-bs-slide-to (0, 1, 2, ...).

     data-bs-interval is the autoplay delay in milliseconds. Delete the
     data-bs-ride attribute entirely if you would rather it not autoplay.
     =================================================================== -->

::: {.column-page}

<div id="lab-gallery" class="carousel slide" data-bs-ride="carousel" data-bs-interval="6000">

<div class="carousel-indicators">
<button type="button" data-bs-target="#lab-gallery" data-bs-slide-to="0" class="active" aria-current="true" aria-label="Slide 1"></button>
</div>

<div class="carousel-inner">

<div class="carousel-item active">
<img src="images/ICB_Variability.jpg" class="d-block w-100" alt="Mixed-severity fire mosaic across a western forest landscape">
<div class="carousel-caption">
<p>Structural variability in a mixed-severity fire landscape.</p>
</div>
</div>

<!-- Copy from here ...
<div class="carousel-item">
<img src="images/your-photo.jpg" class="d-block w-100" alt="Short description of the photo for screen readers">
<div class="carousel-caption">
<p>Your caption here.</p>
</div>
</div>
... to here. -->

</div>

<button class="carousel-control-prev" type="button" data-bs-target="#lab-gallery" data-bs-slide="prev">
<span class="carousel-control-prev-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
<span class="visually-hidden">Previous</span>
</button>
<button class="carousel-control-next" type="button" data-bs-target="#lab-gallery" data-bs-slide="next">
<span class="carousel-control-next-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
<span class="visually-hidden">Next</span>
</button>

</div>

:::
